comment: Version-pinned, architecture-specific bootstrap artifacts for the macOS installer. Every download is verified against sha256 BEFORE it is unpacked or executed; a mismatch aborts the install. Hashes were computed from the downloaded bytes and cross-checked with the publisher's own .sha256 file on 2026-10-29. Update a pin only after repeating both checks.

python.note: Installed by the pinned uv into <root>/app/python (never the system Python). uv 0.13.6 resolves '3.12' to a fixed python-build-standalone build and verifies that build's digest embedded in uv's own metadata.

ffmpeg.publisher: Martin Riedl (ffmpeg.martin-riedl.de), static build; the publisher states the macOS binaries are code-signed
ffmpeg.license: GPL-3.0-or-later build (configured --enable-gpl --enable-version3). Downloaded from the publisher on the user's Mac and run as a separate program; this project does not redistribute it. Source: https://ffmpeg.org/ and the publisher's page.
ffmpeg.codecs_verified: AAC encoders aac/aac_at, MP3 encoder libmp3lame, FLAC, PCM (publisher's codecs.txt for this build)

ffprobe.publisher: Martin Riedl (ffmpeg.martin-riedl.de), static build; the publisher states the macOS binaries are code-signed

native_audio_libraries: libsndfile and PortAudio are not installed separately: the pinned Python wheels for soundfile/sounddevice bundle them on macOS arm64 (tools/check_lock_wheels.py proves a wheel exists for every pin). If a future dependency needs a system library, it must ship as a wheel or be vendored here with a pin.
hosts: github.com and objects.githubusercontent.com / release-assets.githubusercontent.com (uv, and Python builds fetched by uv)
huggingface.co and its CDN (model weights, only when you choose to download them)
